app.title: NeuraDex
app.tagline: Native Linux Control Cockpit & Inference Studio
app.comments: Native Linux Control Cockpit, Model Hub & Inference Studio for Local AI
app.release_notes:
NeuraDex {version} Initial Release:

  • Native Linux Cockpit with real-time VRAM and hardware monitoring
  • Bilingual English and French support with dynamic OS detection
  • Interactive Chat & Playground with tok/s and TTFT streaming metrics
  • Hardware-aware Modelfile tuner and custom parameter compiler
  • Comprehensive Hugging Face GGUF Hub with one-click multi-shard downloads
  • Daemon lifecycle management with systemd overrides and multi-profile key vault

settings.wizard_help_why_desc: Ollama Cloud and private model registries authenticate via SSH public keys. By generating a distinct key for each user or profile, each person can access their own private models and cloud quotas without conflicts.
settings.wizard_help_how_desc:
1. Enter a profile name (e.g. Work, Personal, Laura).
2. Click 'Generate' to create a dedicated Ed25519 key pair.
3. The public key is automatically copied to your clipboard.
4. Paste this key into your ollama.com account settings (or Hugging Face token vault).
5. Click 'Add Profile' to activate it.
